verdict.rationale: Codex CLI explicitly supports non-interactive execution ('Run a non-interactive command in a repeatable workflow'), cloud task delegation with parallel execution, and an MCP server mode for programmatic control, all indicating headless/CI-suitable automation. GitHub install via npm and API key auth further support scripted/CI use, though some caveats exist (MCP server deprecated in favor of app server, some community friction with agentic reliability).
